name: Weels Same-Day Delivery
author: weelsinc

sections.description:
Weels connects your WooCommerce store to a same-day delivery network across the Greater Toronto Area and surrounding regions.

When a customer places an order, the plugin creates a shipping label automatically and adds a tracking number to the order. You can also generate labels manually from the order page.

Features:

  • Automatic or one-click shipping label generation
  • Live same-day delivery rates at checkout
  • Tracking numbers added to order notes (visible to customers)
  • Age-verified delivery (18+, 19+, 21+) for regulated products
  • Digital signature required on delivery
  • Void and regenerate labels from the order page
  • Photo proof of delivery on every shipment

Pricing:

The plugin is free. You pay per delivery through your Weels account starting at $16/package. No monthly fees, no minimums.

Service Area:

Currently delivering across the Greater Toronto Area and surrounding regions in Ontario, Canada.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the weels-same-day-delivery folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Shipping > Weels Same-Day Delivery
  4. Enter your Weels API key (get one at https://www.weels.ca/get-started)
  5. Configure your package defaults and delivery options
  6. Add the shipping method to your WooCommerce shipping zones

For detailed setup instructions, visit https://www.weels.ca/woocommerce
sections.faq:
Do I need a Weels account?

Yes. Sign up for free at weels.ca/get-started, create an organization, and get your API key.

What areas do you deliver to?

We deliver across the Greater Toronto Area and surrounding regions — over 290 postal codes in Ontario.

How does billing work?

Billing goes through your Weels account. Use prepaid credits with auto top-up or get invoiced weekly. The plugin itself is free.

Can I void a label after generating it?

Yes, as long as the package hasn’t been picked up by a driver. Voiding refunds any prepaid credits automatically.
